stories.title: PCA MVP — Officially Jumped Ohtani in NL Race
stories.angle: Pete Crow-Armstrong has jumped ahead of Shohei Ohtani as the NL MVP frontrunner. His 2026 pace: 37 HR, 39 SB, 10.8 fWAR. Ohtani hasn't pitched since July 3. PCA's two-way dominance — top offensive numbers AND MLB-leading defense — makes the argument overwhelming. He's not just winning the award. He's chasing historic numbers.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs
